description: Constrain a value to the inclusive range [low, high]: return low when below, high when above, and the value itself when in range (boundaries inclusive). Pure and deterministic; the floor is two guard clauses and a return, with no input validation (an over-defensive rewrite would add type checks, a low<=high assertion, and None guards the contract does not require). The golden arg_sets cover the value-returning domain: in range, below (clamps to low), above (clamps to high), exactly at the low boundary, exactly at the high boundary, and a degenerate range where low equals high.
constraints: deterministic, pure, no I/O, no randomness, no global state
